source.title: Portrait of Robert Andrews Millikan
source.credit: Courtesy of the Smithsonian Libraries and Archives

preparation: Pillow ImageOps.pad to 640×640 on white, Lanczos resampling, original aspect retained; JPEG quality 92.
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Paper Trails circular timeline portrait. Image 1 is the newly verified Smithsonian identity reference of Robert Andrews Millikan (1868–1953); images 2–4 are approved house-style references only. Do not use any other portrait as an identity reference. Create ONE newly drawn 1024x1024 head-and-shoulders editorial caricature. Recognition anchors: long broad clean-shaven oval face with strong rounded chin and furrow between the brows; high forehead with thick smooth silver-grey hair swept to a neat side part; heavy focused eyes and a small straight mouth, with the distinctive dark polka-dot bow tie shown in the photograph. Preserve these anchors faithfully. Comic idea: a very subtle knowing eyebrow and gently oversized spotted bow tie, secondary to his recognizable likeness. Wry Engraver style like the rutherford, bohr and alfven references: confident near-black charcoal-teal ink contour, simplified graphic shapes, flat restrained colour and at most one shallow shadow, faint paper grain inside coloured shapes. Natural light skin undertones, no yellow/orange/bronze/sepia cast. Charcoal blue-green 1920s suit and cream shirt, period-correct silver-grey hairstyle. Centered bust, hair begins 8% from top, shoulders meet bottom, facial features inside central 76%; clear silhouette that reads at 42px grayscale and 92px colour circular crops. Background: genuine alpha transparency; empty pixels outside the bust; never draw or depict a checkerboard, transparency grid, studio backdrop, halo, or background colour. Output 1024x1024 PNG with decoded alpha. Draw a new caricature, do not colourize the photograph. No text, captions, labels, equations, logos, watermark, apparatus, hands, full body or elaborate background.
normalization: Repository-approved finish-cartoon-asset.ps1 to 1024×1024; removed zero edge-connected background pixels.
